cardholder.responsibility: Named primary person in cardholder_services; roles and card numbers do not substitute
cardholder.primary_scope: Cards and cardholder data in the exact named group, subject to explicit action permissions
cardholder.secondary_scope: Own held cards and linked activity only
cardholder.access_lifecycle: Independent card access role/state/version; card edits, revocation and reinvitation preserve shared merchant membership epochs and merchant grants
cardholder.purchase_scope: Actor's own held card only, including when actor is primary
cardholder.missing_or_suspended_primary: Deny card service access; never infer a replacement
cardholder.customer_profile: One cardholder_profiles row per named primary person; multiple preserved financial scopes appear in one direct card dashboard without unioning grants
cardholder.new_card_destination: Persisted own-scope default, reauthorized for each command; never first account, last-selected context or broadest available permissions
cardholder.dashboard: Direct cards, secondary cardholders, card-linked activity and unfinished requests; no customer account-type directory

merchant.responsibility: Existing immutable master relationship; primary remains responsible for sales, fees, refunds and chargebacks
merchant.primary_scope: Exact primary and its submerchants only, with independently authorized merchant action grants
merchant.submerchant_scope: Exact assigned unit only; no primary or sibling financial data
merchant.network_read: Explicit primary authorization; never a widened submerchant query
merchant.paused_history: Read-only primary oversight does not activate operating commands
merchant.dashboard: Direct authorized payment totals, recent payments/transfers, setup steps and primary/submerchant hierarchy
merchant.creation: Primary merchant setup grants no cardholder service or card permissions; named submerchants use the canonical relationship command with a server-resolved controller binding
merchant.uniqueness: One primary unit per responsible merchant account; multiple independently named subunits may share its controller; immutable master per subunit

shared_invariants: Cardholder access does not grant Merchant access, or vice versa
One policy evaluator, one card request lifecycle, one payment channel workflow, one invitation lifecycle, one financial ledger
Current resource authority is rechecked before protected reads, commands and retry results
Existing account enum values are preserved internal provenance, not customer feature tiers
verification: Executable tests and delivery evidence are recorded separately; this contract is not a passing test result
